name: Godrevy Park Club Campsite
stayType: Caravan and Motorhome Club touring site (members only)
accommodation: 118 touring pitches for caravans and motorhomes; no tent pitches or pods; maximum outfit length 9m
suitableFor: Caravan and Motorhome Club members touring with a caravan or motorhome
dogs: Dog friendly, with a dog walk from the site
beachAccess: Rear gate opens onto the dunes; a ten-minute walk through them reaches the cliff path to the St Ives Bay beach; beach car park about 1 mile by car
confirmedFeatures: Toilet block, accessible shower room, baby changing, laundry, dishwashing, electric hook-up, motorhome service point, Wi-Fi, play area, BBQs allowed, open 20 March to 2 November 2026
overview: A members-only Caravan and Motorhome Club site at Upton Towans, between Hayle and Gwithian. Its rear gate opens straight onto gorse-covered dunes, and a ten-minute walk through them reaches the cliff path above the beach. It takes touring caravans and motorhomes only.
surfTripFit: Members with a van can walk through the dunes to the beach for an early surf. Club membership is required.
